items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tell me about -- what do you think about some of Eddie recent experiments? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's another guy with the same problem... Eddie sit down at a piano to play that, he find faults with the orchestra.

ctx.x: Let's face it, that's exactly what it is. Anybody can analyze it down, and listen to the music. And I like the music, I know exactly what happened.
Tell me about -- what do you think about some of Eddie recent experiments?

That's another guy with the same problem, the same identical problem. They ain't got no label because they don't produce no label. They want to reach the roof but they ain't go no ladder to get over there.
